General information.Name: ecoinvent 3.11 Dataset Documentation: 'lemon production – MX – lemon'
General information.Category: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting/111 Crop Production/1113 Fruit and Tree Nut Farming/111320 Citrus (except Orange) Groves
General information.Description: This dataset represents the production of 1 kg of lemons in Mexico for the export market. The average yield from 2009 - 2012 is 13.8 t/ha. Mineral NPK fertiliser input is 33-0-10 kg/ha. Organic fertilisers applied amount to 1.67 m3/ha of liquid manure and 1.07 t/ha of solid manure. Total active ingredients (a.i.) applied as pesticides amount to 28.6 kg a.i./ha. The activity starts with the nursery producing fruit tree seedlings and ends with the waste treatment after the clearing of the orchard (30 years lifetime). The dataset includes all activities of a year in the productive phase, the establishment phase, and the clearing phase. This includes tree nursery, soil cultivation, planting, irrigation, machine operations, infrastructure, fuel use, direct field emissions, land use change, and heavy metal uptake by the crop. The inputs of seedlings, fertilisers (mineral and organic), pesticides, and their packaging are considered. The dataset does not include emissions from manure storage because these are within the system boundary of animal production.
General information.Tags: lemon, citrus, agriculture, crop production, LCA, ecoinvent, Mexico, WFLDB
General information.Technology Description: Conventional production. The dataset was modelled within the project 'World Food LCA database (WFLDB)'. WFLDB Methodological Guidelines for the Life Cycle Inventory of Agricultural Products were used.

processDocumentation.LCI method: The LCI is based on the WFLDB Methodological Guidelines. Impact assessment methods shown are Ecological Scarcity 2021, EF v3.1, and IPCC 2021.
processDocumentation.Process type: Ordinary transforming activity, representing cradle-to-farm-gate production.
processDocumentation.Modeling constants: System model: Allocation, cut-off. The lifetime of the orchard is assumed to be 30 years.
processDocumentation.Data source information: ecoinvent v3.11, World Food LCA database (WFLDB), FAOSTAT, International Fertilizer Association (IFA), EMEP/EEA, IPCC, and scientific literature (Ozkan B., Freiermuth R., Prasuhn V., etc.).
processDocumentation.Data completeness: The dataset includes all activities from nursery to waste treatment after orchard clearing. It covers seedlings, fertilisers (mineral and organic), pesticides, packaging, machine operations, fuel use, direct field emissions, land use change, and heavy metal uptake. Emissions from manure storage are excluded as they are within the system boundary of animal production.
processDocumentation.Data selection: Data were categorised from level 0 (LO) to level (L4) based on quality (estimate, proxy, statistical, literature, etc.).
processDocumentation.Sampling procedure: WFLDB Methodological Guidelines for the Life Cycle Inventory of Agricultural Products. Data sources were categorised from level 0 (LO) to level (L4) as follows: L0 = estimate, proxy; L1 = statistical data (e.g. FAOSTAT); L2 = L1 adapted to crop and country; L3 = literature data or L1 resp. L2 data approved by experts; L4 = L3 data of high detailing. Data for yield: L1; Fertilisers: L1; Pesticides: L0; Machinery: L0; Irrigation: L2.
processDocumentation.Data collection period: Data for yield is an average from 2009-2012. The dataset is valid for the period 2009-01-01 to 2024-12-31.
processDocumentation.Use advice: This dataset refers to an average situation; for specific situations exchanges might differ substantially due to site specific parameters. PEF-Quality: data quality rating (DQR) = 3.2 (i.e. fair quality).

Sources.citation: Ozkan B., Akcoaz H., Karadeniz F. (2004). Energy requirement and economic analysis of citrus production in Turkey. Energy Conversion and Management, 45.

Faist Emmenegger M., Reinhard J., Zah R. (2009). Sustainability Quick Check for Biofuels – intermediate background report. With contributions from T. Ziep, R. Weichbrodt, Prof. Dr. V. Wohlgemuth, FHTW Berlin and A. Roches, R. Freiermuth Knuchel, Dr. G. Gaillard, Agroscope Reckenholz-Tänikon.
IPCC (2006). 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Prepared by the National Greenhouse Gas Inventories Programme. Volume 4: Agriculture, forestry and other land use.
Freiermuth R. (2006). Modell zur Berechnung der Schwermetallflüsse in der Landwirtschaftlichen Ökobilanz.

Nemecek T., Bengoa X., Lansche J., Mouron P., Rossi V., Humbert S., Riedener E. (2015). World Food LCA Database. Methodological Guidelines for the Life Cycle Inventory of Agricultural Products. Version 3.0.
Prasuhn V. (2006). Erfassung der PO4-Austräge für die Ökobilanzierung - SALCA-Phosphor.

processDocumentation.Intended application: To provide inventories of a broad variety of agricultural products and processes and to cover for each product at least 50% of the global export market.
processDocumentation.Access and use restrictions: The restrictions of use stipulated in the EULA remain applicable for this pdf documentation.
